role: The two-method registry interface (getObject/putObject) behind RegistrySimple, RegistryNamespaced and the block/item registries.

members.name: getObject
members.note: native registries are static tables (BLOCKS, ITEMS) indexed by id instead of a map keyed by name

members.name: putObject
members.note: the tables are fixed at build time; runtime registration does not exist

notes: The registry shape is dissolved into generated tables; test_registry.c checks the block/item id tables against the oracle. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): runtime registry replaced by the generated blocks.h/items.h tables; nothing registers at runtime.
